components.name: Button
components.usage: Use for clear actions in clinical workflows.
antipatterns: Do not use multiple primary buttons in one action group.

components.name: IconButton
components.usage: Use for familiar compact toolbar actions with an accessible label.

components.name: Badge
components.usage: Use for compact metadata, categories, and non-urgent states.
antipatterns: Do not use a badge as a button.

components.name: StatusIndicator
components.usage: Use for live availability and operational state.
antipatterns: Do not communicate status with color alone.

components.name: Input
components.usage: Use for single-line clinical and account data.
antipatterns: Do not use without a visible label in forms.

components.name: Textarea
components.usage: Use for multi-line notes and supporting context.
antipatterns: Do not use for short structured values.

components.name: Select
components.usage: Use for a constrained list of familiar options.
antipatterns: Do not use for only two binary choices.

components.name: Checkbox
components.usage: Use for independent binary choices or multi-select lists.
antipatterns: Do not use for mutually exclusive options.

components.name: Field
components.usage: Use to connect a label, control, hint, and validation message.
antipatterns: Do not duplicate error text outside the field.

components.name: Card
components.usage: Use to frame one coherent object or tool.
antipatterns: Do not nest cards inside cards.

components.name: MetricCard
components.usage: Use for one high-value operational metric and optional trend.
antipatterns: Do not place prose in the value slot.

components.name: Alert
components.usage: Use for important contextual feedback that should remain visible.
antipatterns: Do not use alerts for routine helper text.

components.name: Avatar
components.usage: Use for a person or organization identity.
antipatterns: Do not use decorative images as avatars.

components.name: Tabs
components.usage: Use to switch between peer views without leaving the page.
antipatterns: Do not use tabs as primary site navigation.

components.name: NavigationItem
components.usage: Use for destinations inside a product navigation rail.
antipatterns: Do not use for submit actions.

components.name: Divider
components.usage: Use sparingly to separate adjacent content groups.
antipatterns: Do not use when spacing alone communicates the grouping.

components.name: Spinner
components.usage: Use for indeterminate waits where progress cannot be measured.
antipatterns: Do not show for instantly completed actions.

components.name: GilbertOne
components.usage: Use the animated GilbertOne assistant in product guidance and conversational entry points; the official GilbertOne logo remains a separate complete brand asset.
antipatterns: Do not use GilbertOne as a generic decorative mascot, alter the official logo, or omit its label when informative.

components.name: MyThusoHealthIcon
components.usage: Use branded MyThuso icons for primary patient destinations and healthcare actions.
antipatterns: Do not use for universal utility actions or recolor individual paths with raw values.
